Hi Brad. I've checked Priya Raman's and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where they are both free for the partner meeting next week.

Tue Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed Nov 18: 9:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu Nov 19: 10:00

Can you please check these times against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars? Let me know which of these, if any, work for them. Thanks.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad. This is my last session and I have not heard from you. I was unable to book the partner meeting as I still need to know which of the times I proposed work for Elena Soto and David Okafor. I am now out of sessions and cannot complete the task. Alison.
